g.text: A half adder adds two bits. It outputs the digit for this
column and the carry for the next one.
Write 1 when exactly one input is 1: that is XOR.
Carry 1 only when both are 1: that is AND.
Set X = Y = 1: the sum lamp is off and the carry lamp is on.
That is the 10 we need when we add one and one.
